name: Namekian Vigilant Mastery
Text: [CONSTANT]: Any attacks performed by your MP deal +1 life card. [INSTANT] POWER: Use when you would Rejuvenate any number of cards during combat. Banish them instead to search your Life Deck for a Styled or Named Drill and place it into play.

name: Blue Preventive Mastery
Text: [DEFENSE] POWER: Use only on the first attack your opponent performs in combat. Prevent all damage from this attack. You may discard a card from your hand. If you do, this attack deals no damage. POWER: The next time one of your opponent's effects would raise their anger this combat, change that amount to 0.

name: Black Ominous Mastery
Text: (You cannot win by MPPV) [CONSTANT]: Your Styled attacks deal +1 stage and +1 life card. [INSTANT] POWER: Use when one of your effects discards or banishes the last card in your opponent's hand. Advance or lower your MP 1 level. POWER: Banish the top 2 cards of your opponent's discard pile. The next time one of your Styled effects discards a card from your opponent's hand during combat, the card is chosen at random.

name: Saiyan Surging Mastery
Text: (You cannot win by MPPV) [CONSTANT]: Your Styled attacks gain "Raise your anger 1." At the start of the Discard Step, if your MP advanced a level this turn, lower your MP 1 level. [INSTANT] POWER: Use when an effect lowers your MP 1 or more levels. Draw a card. POWER: Your next Styled attack this combat deals +X life cards. X = your MP's level.

name: Red Primal Mastery
Text: [CONSTANT]: Your attacks cost -1 stage (this effect cannot lower a cost to 0). [INSTANT] POWER: Use when you would use a critical damage effect during combat. Raise your anger 2 instead. POWER: Rejuvenate X. X = your current anger level.

name: Orange Cunning Mastery
Text: [CONSTANT]: Your attacks deal +1 life card. Whenever a Drill you own would be discarded due to your MP changing levels, you may Rejuvenate it instead. [INSTANT] POWER: Use when you would use a critical damage effect during combat. Search your Life Deck for a Styled Still and place it into play instead. [POWER]: Rejuvenate a Drill from your discard pile.

name: Red Spinal Fracture
Text: [ATTACK] Physical attack. Lower your opponent's anger 2. If you have banished cards from your Life Deck this turn, Unpreventable. DAMAGE: 6 Stages. HIT: Rejuvenate after use.
